title: Atakhan, Rek'Sai, and Accelerate
explanation: Paying Atakhan's Accelerate cost creates a delayed replacement effect that makes it enter ready. Killing Rek'Sai for Atakhan's additional cost can remove the keyword before resolution, but does not remove the already-created delayed replacement effect.
